TITLE (verbatim): Retrieve candidates, augment context, validate decisions

ILLUSTRATED COMPOSITION: Use a continuous six-stop illustrated journey with large numbered circles and flowing arrows: repository documents -> magnifying glass searching canonical tag cards -> policy sieve with crossed-out rejected tags -> context recipe/document -> friendly robot producing JSON -> human checking a clipboard. Use two rows in a snake path. Facts appear in small readable checklists below each illustration. Include the ranking-versus-reranker limitation in a highlighted footer note.

REQUIRED CONTENT, ALL FACTS AND QUALIFICATIONS MUST BE SHOWN:
- Sparse candidate retrieval is implemented. Dense embeddings and a neural reranker are absent.

- RAKE phrases preserve source links
- Retrieval query uses all evidence
- 2 · Canonical candidate search
- Name + description + aliases
- Binary-IDF cosine + alias boost
- PROJECT 8 · TOPIC 10 · TAG 12

- Exclude existing accepted edges

- Active concepts; Domain is derived

- Metadata + first 2 purpose blocks

- Classification model / low effort

- IDs, kinds, evidence references
- Current access / decision / fence
- Save receipt; user reviews proposal
- Reference validity ≠ entailment
